model.title: Quinault Indian Nation Land Transfer Act
model.meta: Indian Affairs Committee · Sen. Maria Cantwell (D-WA)

summary.text: The bill would transfer approximately 72 acres of federal forest land in Washington to the Department of the Interior, which would then hold it in trust for the Quinault Indian Nation as part of the tribe's reservation. The measure prohibits gambling on the transferred land and requires the department to disclose any hazardous substances on the property, though it would not require cleanup of those substances.
